Package io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.managers

Class GameManager

java.lang.Object
io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.managers.GameManager
public class GameManager extends Object
GameManager is the class that manages most aspects of the gameplay itself, keeping track of Geese through GooseManager, the student using Student, etc. It is used by GameScreen which properly adds all the UI elements to it
